description: This PHP class 'Report' is an entity model for representing report data in the OrangeHRM system. It maps to the 'ohrm_report' database table and defines properties such as id, name, reportGroup, useFilterField, and type, along with corresponding getter and setter methods. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for object-relational mapping.

classes.name: Report
classes.description: Entity class representing a report in the OrangeHRM system, mapped to the 'ohrm_report' table with properties for report details and relationships.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the report.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the report.

methods.name: setReportGroup
methods.description: Associates this report with a ReportGroup.

methods.name: isUseFilterField
methods.description: Returns whether the report uses a filter field.

methods.name: setUseFilterField
methods.description: Sets whether the report uses a filter field.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the report, if any.
